description: The problems of one entity's options, as DefinitionDocument.Options gives them: each case is one entity of a graph definition (key, domain, name when it has one, options) and the problems the server answers for it, in order: code, inputId (the entity's key), portId (the option the problem is about; null when it is about no one option) and message (messageStartsWith where the tail is the regular expression engine's own words). A case marked local is one the panel finds itself (optionProblems), in the same words. Consumed by tests/Runtime (EntityStoreTests) and by the frontend's in-memory backend and optionProblems tests.
